column8: Estimates: Every instrument is unique and it is impossible to know *exactly* how much time a repair or restoration will take. Estimates are based on our prior experience and we do our best to communicate them as accurately as possible before services begin. If a budget is limited to a specific amount please let us know before we begin services.
